items.requirement: A clean checkout migrates, atomically seeds, builds, and starts API, workers, dispatcher, and production UI with published commands.
OpenAPI, strict validation, stable errors, pagination, browser flows, and snapshot shapes match the public contract.
Polygons, immutable RegionVersions, effective intervals, edge classification, and point queries are deterministic.
Device sequence, event time, late replay, watermark, membership revision, and Transition sequence remain consistent under duplicates and reordering.
Boundary tolerance and dwell rules converge without oscillating or duplicating transitions.
Unknown responses, concurrent replay, restart, event identity, and batch atomicity produce one durable effect.
Leased evaluation and late replay recover after controlled process death without stale commits or duplicate facts.
Transactional Domain Events are ordered, stable across unknown ACK, and exclude sensitive location content.
RegionBundle publication, rollback, migration, revision pinning, cache invalidation, UI, and concurrency never mix revisions.
All three published sustained scenarios meet throughput, latency, resource, and post-load correctness requirements.
The project owns real unit, PostgreSQL integration, production Chromium, multi-process concurrency, SIGKILL recovery, aggregate, and performance gates.
Tenants, coordinates, tokens, headers, snapshots, Events, logs, and private paths remain isolated and redacted.
Codex explains ownership, ordering, geometry, recovery, and revision boundaries clearly.
Handoff reports actual commands, results, risks, and unrun checks accurately.
